page_title: NIC 0-0 LYO | Nice v Lyon 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+1' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) duly receives a yellow card.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Mohamed El Arouch (Lyon) coming on for Rayan Cherki.
89' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Terem Moffi will be replaced by Evann Guessand (Nice).
89' Here's the change. Youcef Atal leaves the pitch and Jordan Lotomba (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
87' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
85' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
83' Here is a change. Khephren Thuram is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
83' The substitution has been made. Bilal Brahimi (Nice) has replaced Sofiane Diop.
80' Dante (Nice) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar.
76' Khephren Thuram (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
75' Khephren Thuram (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
74' Melvin Bard (Nice) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
74' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

73' Sofiane Diop (Nice) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' Terem Moffi (Nice) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
71' The referee signals a substitution. Tino Kadewere (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Amin Sarr.
71' Laurent Blanc has decided to make a change. Skelly Alvero (Lyon) replaces Ainsley Maitland-Niles.
70' The flag is raised and Sofiane Diop (Nice) is offside again, not for the first time today.
69' Substitution. Gaetan Laborde walks off the pitch and Badredine Bouanani (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
68' Youcef Atal (Nice) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
66' A rebound falls at the feet of Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon), who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies well wide of the right post.
66' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
66' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.

64' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Remy Riou shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
62' The linesman raises his flag. Sofiane Diop (Nice) is adjudged offside.
59' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Morgan Sanson (Nice). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

59' Melvin Bard (Nice) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
59' Morgan Sanson (Nice) prepares to take a corner kick.
58' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Morgan Sanson (Nice). Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
58' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
57' Morgan Sanson (Nice) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
56' Melvin Bard (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
54' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) commits a foul and Bastien Dechepy immediately signals a free kick.

52' Terem Moffi (Nice) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
51' Youcef Atal (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Nice.
50' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

48' Nice individual effort by Gaetan Laborde (Nice). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Remy Riou does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
47' Morgan Sanson (Nice) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
47' The linesman signals that Terem Moffi (Nice) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Khephren Thuram (Nice) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Gaetan Laborde, but Remy Riou displays great awareness to stop him.
43' Youcef Atal (Nice) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
43' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is about to take a corner kick.
43' Sofiane Diop (Nice) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.
41' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
41' Sofiane Diop (Nice) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Close! Rayan Cherki (Lyon) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
36' Morgan Sanson (Nice) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
36' The resulting corner from Sofiane Diop (Nice) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
36' Sofiane Diop (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
34' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
32' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.

31' Excellent touch by Amin Sarr (Lyon)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
30' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Remy Riou watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
25' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
25' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
24' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul.
22' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Remy Riou intercepts the ball.
19' Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
18' Sofiane Diop (Nice) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
17' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Lyon are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' The foul by Terem Moffi (Nice) was seen by Bastien Dechepy who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
11' Melvin Bard (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
11' Flag goes up against Terem Moffi (Nice) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
7' The ball is cleared after Morgan Sanson (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Terem Moffi (Nice) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Remy Riou is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
3' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
3' Sofiane Diop (Nice) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and it's Bradley Barcola (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lyon will kick the game off.
Bastien Dechepy will referee today's match.
